sourceNote: The abbreviated commit of the packaged build these frames were taken from. The picker and dialogs were polished afterwards (left-aligned repository names, top-aligned list, repositories with drives first), so the current look differs slightly.

executable.note: The build was made and driven by another session; its hash was not recorded here.

captureMethod: Playwright _electron launch of the packaged executable in an isolated throwaway profile, driven through the real user interface: Create a drive, Docker Hub, repository picker, create, first sync, lock, delete the local copy, Open from Docker Hub, restore and unlock. Window screenshots at device scale factor 1.
captureHost: Windows 11 x64, 1440 by 900 window, signed in to a real Docker Hub account. The account name shown is the public repository namespace.
privacy: Every frame was inspected by eye before inclusion. Frames that showed the local profile path (a user name) or the names of other repositories were left out, and no pixels were edited.
notIncluded: 12-click-create-drive and 13-drive-created-first-sync: the details panel shows the local profile path with a user name. Not edited, so not included.
30-restored-drive-shows-file: the details panel shows the local profile path. Not included.
22-choose-docker-hub and 23-press-refresh-in-picker: the repository list shows the names of other repositories of the account, including a private one. Not included.
